integerToken: 0|[1-9][0-9]*; non-negative; <= 9007199254740991; fractions, exponents, signs, and leading zeros are forbidden

commandRules.bind: First command must be bind with an unused random commandId; bridge-bound means only private bridge binding
commandRules.subsequent: Unordered random IDs; retain all accepted IDs (maximum 4096 per binding, then terminal); at most one non-dispose command is inflight; never evict IDs
commandRules.correlation: host ack, error, model, and location use the same commandId as their command
commandRules.dispose: Supersedes an inflight command and closes after ack/error; transfer abort may also supersede. Bare hn-foliate-transfer remains invalid.
commandRules.sourceGate: Bind is source-free. Only a correlated probe/source-authorized ack permits closed transfer payloads.

identifier: session, generation, commandId: independently adapter-generated 32 random bytes, unpadded base64url, exactly 43 characters
identityRules: Authenticate transport, scan bounded strict JSON, ignore provably stale direction/session/generation, then validate current schema and ledger. Never use permissive JSON parsing for identity.
